name: Shareate Tools Ltd.
summary: Shareate Tools Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of cemented carbide and drilling tools in China and internationally. The company offers mining tri-cone drill bit and water well bits; DTH hammer and bit; horizontal directional drilling products comprises reamers and single roller cone bit; core barrel roller bit; raise bore tools; and top hammer drilling tools.
